# Metrics

`GET /metrics` serves these in the Prometheus text format, without sign-in: scrape it from inside the cluster and don't route it through your Ingress. Counters start at 0 when the pod starts.

| Metric | Type | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openconsole_http_requests_total` | counter |  | HTTP requests served. |
| `openconsole_http_requests_status_total` | counter | `status` | HTTP requests served, by status class (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx). |
| `openconsole_http_request_duration_ms_sum` | counter |  | Sum of request durations in milliseconds. |
| `openconsole_http_request_duration_ms_count` | counter |  | Count of observed requests used for duration stats. |
| `openconsole_audit_events_total` | counter |  | Audit log entries recorded. |
| `openconsole_pod_exec_sessions_total` | counter |  | Pod exec sessions started. |
| `openconsole_pod_log_streams_total` | counter |  | Pod log WebSocket streams started. |
| `openconsole_deployment_actions_total` | counter |  | Deployment restart or scale actions attempted. |
| `openconsole_pod_exec_active` | gauge |  | Pod exec sessions currently open. |
| `openconsole_cluster_requests_total` | counter | `cluster` | Authenticated API requests per cluster. |
| `openconsole_cluster_connected` | gauge | `cluster` | 1 when OpenConsole holds a live connection to the cluster. |
